long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in A Coruña, Jove first worked in his father's carpentry shop. At the age of twenty he formed Ángel Jove Construcciones and gradually developed it into Anjoca. The enterprise moved beyond homebuilding into tourism, commercial property, elder care and water treatment, while its hotel chain became the dominant operating division by revenue. Its projects spread across Spain, Europe, Latin America and North Africa.

Motoring had interested him since adolescence, when he raced and tested motorcycles. Following his son Jorge's death, he created a memorial foundation dedicated to automotive heritage. Its plans eventually produced the Museo de Automoción e Historia, which opened in Arteixo in 2023 and placed transport technology within a wider cultural narrative. Jove died in his native city on 23 August 2025.
